learning_outcomes.text: Can use assembly commands and write assembly programs.
Understand the internal structure and memory hierarchy of the microprocessor.
Can make a project using microprocessor / microcontroller.

syllabus_topics: General information about microprocessors and architectures
Concept of instruction set architecture and general structure of microprocessor
Binary encoding of instructions and instruction formats
Performance calculation and run times of instructions
Programming of input / output ports - I
Programming of input / output ports - II
bibliography: Embedded Systems: Real-Time Operating Systems for ARM Cortex M Microcontrollers, Jonathan W. Valvano
Embedded Systems: Real-Time Interfacing to ARM Cortex M Microcontrollers, Jonathan W. Valvano
ARM System-on-Chip Architecture, Steve Furber, 2nd Edition, 2000
Embedded Systems: Introduction To ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers, Jonathan W. Valvano
